intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Madison for 2026, and here is what he found: 20 family events, 8 of them free. The magic runs from the Edgewater Holiday Tree Lighting (November 27) and the Maple Bluff Holiday Parade (November 29) through the Holiday Express Model Train and Flower Show at Olbrich Botanical Gardens (December 5 to January 3), with Zoo Lights at Henry Vilas Zoo, Madison Ballet's Nutcracker at Overture Hall (December 11 to 20), A Christmas Carol and The Pigeon Gets a Big Time Holiday Extravaganza at Children's Theater of Madison and Breakfast with Santa at Henry Vilas Zoo (December 12) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Madison

  • 20 Christmas events for kids in Madison
  • 8 free events, including the Edgewater Holiday Tree Lighting, the Maple Bluff Holiday Parade and Tree Lighting, the library Nutcracker storytimes, the Gingerbread Party and the Pop-up Pajama Puppet Theater
  • Meet Santa: Visit Santa at Hilldale (November 28 to December 23), Skate with Santa in Monona (December 12), Breakfast with Santa at Henry Vilas Zoo (December 12) and the Santa Breakfasts at The Edgewater
  • Shows and ballet: Madison Ballet's The Nutcracker (December 11 to 20), A Christmas Carol and The Pigeon Gets a Big Time Holiday Extravaganza, plus the Dance Wisconsin Nutcracker (December 13)
  • Lights and trains: Zoo Lights, the Wisconsin State Capitol Holiday Tree Lighting (December 1) and the Holiday Express Model Train and Flower Show at Olbrich
  • Season: November 27 to January 3

Planning a bigger day out? Madison families also use our guides to Christmas activities for kids in Middleton, Verona, Mount Horeb and Waunakee, all a short drive from the Capitol Square.
